commit_message: Fix ADR0133 visual capture lifecycle and full validation
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0133 Remote AI Studio first release
pr_body:
## Summary

- add exact-head Remote AI Studio browser visual validation using the real loopback gateway and production companion HTML/JS
- seed deterministic Agent Host state only under the `visual-validation` feature
- capture desktop, narrow, and mobile browser viewports plus tall companion evidence
- keep unique Edge visual-validation profiles alive for the Windows job lifetime so Edge child processes cannot lose their ProcessSingleton directory between captures
- move the pre-existing Animation Set test module to the end of its file so current-main full clippy validation is not blocked by `items_after_test_module`
- keep the accepted visual-validation spec version at 1.5

## Validation

- exact final-head full Windows Validation
- Automation Regression because `scripts/ci/**` changes
- Remote browser visual review at desktop, narrow, and mobile widths
